test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Rural Self - Employment Training Institute is an initiative of which Ministry of the Government of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Rural Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rural Self-Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs)** are an initiative under the **Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India**.
 
• These institutes aim to provide **vocational training** to rural youth, enabling them to take up self-employment or wage employment opportunities.
 
• The program focuses on **skill development** to empower the rural population, especially those below the poverty line (BPL).
 
• The **National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM)**, a flagship program of the MoRD, supports RSETIs to enhance livelihood opportunities in rural areas.
 
• Each RSETI is typically set up in partnership with **banks and state governments**, ensuring a robust public-private collaboration.
 
• The training provided is **free of cost** and includes a variety of sectors such as **agriculture, business, and services** to cater to diverse employment needs.
 
• The initiative also emphasizes **hand-holding support** post-training to ensure the sustainability of self-employment ventures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture**__

 __
 
• The Ministry of Agriculture focuses on **agricultural development**, including crop production, irrigation management, and farmer welfare.
 
• It oversees programs like **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana** and **Soil Health Card Scheme**.
 
• While related to rural livelihoods, it does not directly manage **RSETIs**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Labour and Employment**__
 __
 
• This ministry is responsible for **policies related to employment, workforce welfare, and labor laws**.
 
• It implements programs like the **National Career Service** and **Employees’ State Insurance Scheme**.
 
• Its focus is more on the organized and unorganized workforce than rural self-employment training.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Finance**__
 
 
• The Ministry of Finance primarily deals with **fiscal policies, economic development, and financial regulations.**
 
• It oversees programs such as **PM Jan Dhan Yojana** and **Direct Benefit Transfers** to promote financial inclusion.
 
• Although it supports rural development indirectly through financial schemes, it does not operate **RSETIs**.
